findings: ROOT CAUSE of the hard fail: game/src/save/state.js buildSave() world.entities projection omits e.prevState; applySave() therefore leaves it at makeEntity's null. record.js line 126 emits prev_state, so it shows in every trace.

WHY R9 MISSED IT: determinism.mjs R9 loads the bare named state (scenario.state) WITHOUT running scenario.setup, so no entity is ever spawned in the R9 round trip, and it compares only a sha256 of the two 600-frame tails with no field diff. Two independent holes.

ENTITY AUDIT (source read, to be confirmed by measurement): unsaved-but-stateful entity fields are prevState, phase, yawRate, speed, hitById, attackToken, anim. phase and yawRate survive the `continue` paths (hitstop, stagger) so they are genuinely stale-able; hitById is the per-swing hit-dedupe key, so a save/load mid-swing lets the SAME hitbox instance hit the same entity twice.

PLAYER AUDIT: pose omits moveDirDeg and speedMps. Both persist across frames (moveDirDeg is only assigned while moving; speedMps is not reset during hitstop), and both are in the trace record (player.move_dir_deg, player.speed_mps).
CAMERA AUDIT: pose omits shakeYaw/shakePitch/shakeUntil/shakeAmp. triggerShake() is never called in wave 1 so they cannot diverge today, but they are durable sim state.

SEED REACH: every named state in game/data/states/*.json pins env.timeOfDay and env.weather, so there is nothing unpinned in env for a seed to select. The renderer/terrain IS seeded (scene.js terrainHeight(x,z,seed)) but with a HARDCODED 1337 (engine.js: new Renderer(canvas, 1337)), independent of the sim seed - so setSeed() changes no world geometry at all. groundAt() feeds player.pos[1] and entity pos[1], which are in the trace and durable in the save (pose.pos).
HARNESS.md line 147 and its screenshot table forbid random weather transitions ('no random weather rolls'), so seeding weather is out; RI-WLD08 owns weather state machines anyway.

FIXED + PROVEN: p10-m5.mjs (the critic's own probe, unmodified) now gives control == loaded == 5d0830f9b9e3ea71... , differing_fields {}. The control hash is UNCHANGED from the failing baseline, so the loaded side moved to meet the control.
NEW instrument tools/journey/state-diff.mjs (named by RI-JRN05 line 213, previously absent): M1/M2/M4/M5 + the live-object census, 12/12 clean over 3 states x 4 seeds.

The richer pre-roll found THREE more pre-existing defects the single-hash check could not see: (a) pose.anim_stamp_ago_frames did not round-trip once the player had swung (80 -> -1, M1 hash mismatch) - replaced by a durable monotonic player.swingSeq; (b) quest.topicsKnown came back re-ordered on sv1-midquest (the save sorts declared-incidental arrays, the live state did not); (c) the 6-dp serialisation rule is LOSSY, and a 1e-7 m difference at the save point diverged the 600-frame trace on enemies[].dist_m and camera.pos - fixed by snapping the sim to the save grid at the bottom of every step (quantiseSaveGrid).
Also fixed: camera.pivot/pos held makeCamera() defaults between a load and the first step, so snapshot() straight after a load reported a camera at the world origin.
